First, we write $9$ as a fraction:

$$
9= \dfrac{9} 1
$$

To find the reciprocal of a fraction, we switch the numerator and the denominator:

$$
\dfrac{\color{blue}9}{\color{red}1} \quad\rightarrow\quad \dfrac{\color{red}1}{\color{blue}9}
$$

So the reciprocal of $9$ is $\dfrac{1}{9}.$
